units.source_text: 我赶回家时，父亲的遗体已经收殓了。

en.t: By the time I hurried home, my father's body had already been laid in the coffin.

units.source_text: 因为我徒步走到内浦，再乘船沿海湾回到成生，花了整整一天的时间。

en.t: It had taken me a whole day, because I walked to Uchiura and then returned to Nariu by boat along the bay.

units.source_text: 时值梅雨季节前夕，天天曝晒，气候炎热。

en.t: It was just before the rainy season, with blazing sun day after day and stifling heat.

units.source_text: 我告别遗体之后，匆匆将灵抠运往荒凉的海角火葬场，在海岸边焚烧了。

en.t: After taking leave of the body, I hurriedly carried the coffin to the desolate crematorium on the cape and had it burned by the shore.
